sfx.purpose: Status words and the wordmark; paper-outlined.

headline.purpose: Section heads, paired with a Rozha One Devanagari line.

title.purpose: Quest titles, tracker head, task names.

label.purpose: Caption tabs and ledger heads; stamps at 11px.

pencil.purpose: Spot-backed margin notes, spoken hints, said-back lines.

devanagari-head.purpose: Companion line to headlines and the tracker head.

devanagari-sub.purpose: Nav subs and Devanagari inside tabs.

frames.name: inset
frames.purpose: Captions, buttons, keycaps, slots, ledger rows.

frames.name: splash
frames.purpose: Conversation, overlay panel, today's day cell, lock brackets, Work entity.

frames.name: underdrawing
frames.purpose: Behind every panel; structure, never state.

shadows.name: lock-halo
shadows.purpose: The only box-shadow in the system: keeps overlay lock brackets legible over any app.

motion.name: ease-ink
motion.purpose: All entrances and the orb breath.

motion.name: ink-on
motion.value: 300ms clip-path inset wipe, 40ms stagger per corner
motion.purpose: Lock brackets inking onto what Nova read.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 460ms after 260ms delay; translateY 24px to 0, rotate -.6deg to -.4deg
motion.purpose: Overlay answer panel after the lock.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: Live orb, only while status is busy.

motion.name: slide
motion.purpose: Screentone fill in the running bar while a job runs.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action: paper box, 2px ink, inverts on hover.
components.css: :host{--paper:#f5f5f2;--pen:#0d0d0d;--pen-2:#3b3b3b;--guide:#a9c8e8;--spot:#ff1f6f;--faint:#6a6a66;--text:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Mukta',system-ui,sans-serif;--sfx:'Dela Gothic One','Rozha One',sans-serif;--pencil:'Klee One','Mukta',cursive;--ease-ink:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:2px solid var(--pen);border-radius:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--pen);font:900 13.5px var(--text);padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 120ms,color 120ms}.ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--pen);color:var(--paper)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--spot);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn:disabled{border-style:dashed;color:var(--faint);cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Spot Button
components.description: The one primary action of a quest, with its F-key.
components.css: :host{--paper:#f5f5f2;--pen:#0d0d0d;--pen-2:#3b3b3b;--guide:#a9c8e8;--spot:#ff1f6f;--faint:#6a6a66;--text:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Mukta',system-ui,sans-serif;--sfx:'Dela Gothic One','Rozha One',sans-serif;--pencil:'Klee One','Mukta',cursive;--ease-ink:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-key{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:22px;height:20px;padding:0 6px;border:2px solid var(--pen);border-bottom-width:3px;background:var(--paper);font:900 11px var(--text);color:var(--pen)}.ds-btn-spot{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:3px solid var(--pen);border-radius:0;background:var(--spot);color:var(--pen);font:900 13.5px var(--text);padding:6px 12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 120ms,color 120ms}.ds-btn-spot:hover{background:var(--pen);color:var(--spot)}.ds-btn-spot:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--spot);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Compose Field
components.description: Borderless input inside a 3px ink frame with the spot send square.

Nova decides when to act."><button type="button" class="ds-send" aria-label="Send"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="#0d0d0d" stroke-width="2.8" stroke-linecap="square"><path d="M2 9h12M9 3l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button></form>
components.css: :host{--paper:#f5f5f2;--pen:#0d0d0d;--pen-2:#3b3b3b;--guide:#a9c8e8;--spot:#ff1f6f;--faint:#6a6a66;--text:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Mukta',system-ui,sans-serif;--sfx:'Dela Gothic One','Rozha One',sans-serif;--pencil:'Klee One','Mukta',cursive;--ease-ink:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-compose{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px 10px 18px;border:3px solid var(--pen);background:var(--paper)}.ds-compose input{flex:1;border:0;background:none;outline:none;font:700 16px var(--text);color:var(--pen);min-width:0}.ds-compose input::placeholder{color:var(--pen-2)}.ds-compose:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--spot);outline-offset:3px}.ds-send{width:44px;height:44px;border:3px solid var(--pen);background:var(--spot);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}.ds-send:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--pen);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Space Nav
components.description: Masthead spaces: keycap, English label, Devanagari sub; the current space underlined in spot.

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Rubber-stamp tag; solid for counts, dashed for scheduled or proposed.
components.html: Draft Scheduled post 2 of 5

components.name: Panel with Underdrawing
components.description: The base frame: 3px ink square over a rotated guide-blue underdrawing; splash panels go to 5px.
components.html: Nothing is waiting on you. Drafts, scheduled posts and proposed automations land here.
components.css: :host{--paper:#f5f5f2;--pen:#0d0d0d;--pen-2:#3b3b3b;--guide:#a9c8e8;--spot:#ff1f6f;--faint:#6a6a66;--text:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Mukta',system-ui,sans-serif;--sfx:'Dela Gothic One','Rozha One',sans-serif;--pencil:'Klee One','Mukta',cursive;--ease-ink:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-panel{position:relative;background:var(--paper);padding:16px 18px;margin:8px;isolation:isolate;font:700 15px var(--text);color:var(--pen-2)}.ds-panel p{margin:0}.ds-panel::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border:3px solid var(--pen);pointer-events:none;z-index:2}.ds-panel::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:5px -6px -6px 5px;border:1.5px solid var(--guide);transform:rotate(-.4deg);opacity:.65;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}

narrative.overview:
Nova is drawn, not rendered. Every surface is a page of manuscript: off-white paper, G-pen black ink, a non-repro blue underdrawing that structure hangs from, and exactly one spot ink, pink, for what happens next or what is live right now. Panels are square ink frames whose stroke weight carries hierarchy; the only curves on the page are the speech balloon and Nova's screentone orb, because those are the parts that speak and breathe. The HUD half of the world contributes mechanics, not chrome: keycaps for the four spaces (1-4) and the first three decisions (F1-F3), numbered spoken choices, and ink lock brackets that close onto what Nova read.

The canvas and the overlay are the same page. Opened in its window, Nova's page splits into the conversation (7/12) and the quests waiting on the owner (5/12), with today as a single inked timeline along the bottom gutter. Summoned over another app, the same grammar appears as one tilted splash panel over a dimmed still of the screen: portrait with nameplate, the heard question as a caption, the answer as a balloon, numbered choices with the first in spot. Density is moderate and reading-first; paper stays visible around every frame.

Every reading surface is bilingual by construction: an English line in Zen Kaku Gothic New with a Devanagari companion in Rozha One or Mukta, on nav items, section heads and caption tabs. The world draws its SFX words (Dela Gothic One, paper-outlined) from the real status slice: "listening...", "thinking...", "GOT IT!".
keyCharacteristics: Paper and ink, light scheme only (`color-scheme: light`); depth is frame weight and underdrawing, never shadow.
Square frames at 2 / 3 / 5px; balloons (26px) and the orb (circle) are the only curves.
One spot pink, used as a fill under ink: next action, live state, now.
Screentone dots (radial-gradient dot grids) for tone; no airbrushed gradients.
Keycaps and numbered choices mirror the voice path; every button has a spoken twin.
English paired with Devanagari on navigation, headings and caption tabs.

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: Pink marks the next action or the live state, one per cluster: the primary button of a quest, the first of the choices, the now tick, the live orb. A second pink element in the same panel means one of them is lying.

rules.name: The Spot Is a Fill Rule
rules.body: Pink sits under ink, never as text on paper (pink on paper is about 3.4:1). Where pink text appears it is on ink (the spot button's hover).

rules.name: The Non-Repro Rule
rules.body: Guide blue draws structure that a printer would drop: margins and underdrawing. If removing it loses information, it was the wrong color.

rules.name: The Bilingual Line Rule
rules.body: Navigation, section heads and caption tabs carry an English line and a Devanagari companion (`lang="hi"`). The Devanagari is a second voice, never a translation table.

rules.name: The Speech Is Bold Rule
rules.body: Anything spoken, by Nova or by the owner, is set at 700. Regular weight is for context and metadata.

rules.name: The Weight Not Lift Rule
rules.body: To raise importance, thicken the frame (3px to 5px) or fill it; never add a shadow or a radius.

rules.name: The Screentone Rule
rules.body: Tone is dots of ink. Gradients appear only as dot grids and the orb's white highlight, never as a color blend.

dos: **Do** express hierarchy with frame weight: 2px inset, 3px panel, 5px splash (conversation, overlay panel, today's day cell).
**Do** keep spot pink to one live or next-action element per cluster, always with ink on or around it.
**Do** pair every nav item, section head and caption tab with a Devanagari line (`lang="hi"`).
**Do** give every primary action a key or a spoken number, and show the keycap only where the key works.
**Do** use dashed borders for anything scheduled, proposed or unavailable.
**Do** guard all motion with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, using `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`.
**Do** self-host every face in `canvas/public/fonts` so the page looks the same offline.
donts: **Don't** add box-shadows or rounded corners to frames, cards, buttons or inputs; curves belong to balloons and the orb.
**Don't** set pink text on paper, or use guide blue for anything but structure.
**Don't** blend colors in gradients; tone is screentone dots.
**Don't** put a caption tab or uppercase tracked label above a section heading as decoration; tabs attribute speech and sources.
**Don't** animate the orb or entity without a real status behind it.
**Don't** design new surfaces in the legacy Living Ink vocabulary (Fraunces, Plex Mono, coral, violet, dark ground); `styles.css` is legacy that `manga.css` overrides.
